Conditional branching.

**Status:** Can't run yet (Coming soon): the node is listed under **Can't run yet** in the palette and cannot be added to a graph.

Routes data to different outputs based on a condition. True branch receives data if condition is met.

## Settings

The node has no settings.

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.
